result.description:
OFFICE MANAGER
Crossbay Pty Ltd T/A Drive Ready Australia
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 
Employment Type: Full-time 
Salary: $79,423 plus Superannuation 
About Us
Drive Ready Australia is a growing vehicle rental and automotive services company based in Perth. We manage a fleet of more than 200 vehicles and are committed to delivering reliable rental solutions and outstanding customer service. We are seeking an experienced and organised Office Manager to oversee our administrative operations and support the continued growth of our business.
Key Responsibilities
The successful applicant will be responsible for:
•	Managing the day-to-day administrative and operational activities of the business. 
•	Coordinating communication between customers, workshop staff, suppliers and management. 
•	Managing financial administration, including rental payments, driver payments, bank reconciliations, outstanding accounts, payment plans and daily financial reporting. 
•	Administering end-to-end motor vehicle insurance claims, including preparing documentation, liaising with insurers and monitoring claims until completion. 
•	Coordinating fleet administration for more than 200 vehicles, including maintenance scheduling, repairs, onboarding and offboarding, GPS installations and vehicle availability. 
•	Preparing repair quotations, sourcing vehicle parts, liaising with suppliers and panel beaters, and supporting workshop operations. 
•	Preparing operational, financial, fleet and insurance reports for management. 
•	Supervising office administration, allocating tasks, assisting with staff onboarding and providing administrative support to employees. 
•	Preparing rental agreements, maintaining electronic records and ensuring accurate business documentation. 
•	Building strong relationships with customers, suppliers, insurers and business partners while resolving enquiries professionally. 
•	Identifying opportunities to improve office procedures and administrative efficiency. 
Essential Requirements
Applicants should possess:
•	At least an AQF Diploma or higher qualification in Business, Management, Administration or a related field; or at least three years of relevant full-time work experience. 
•	Demonstrated experience in office management or business administration. 
•	Strong organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. 
•	Experience in financial administration, including reconciliations and reporting. 
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
•	High level of computer literacy, including Microsoft Office and business management software. 
•	Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. 
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 
Desirable
•	Experience in the motor vehicle, transport, fleet management or automotive industry. 
•	Experience dealing with insurance claims and vehicle fleet administration. 
•	Knowledge of accounting software such as Xero. 
Benefits
•	Competitive salary package. 
•	Stable full-time employment. 
•	Supportive and friendly working environment. 
•	Opportunities for career growth and professional development. 
How to Apply
Please submit your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

The Client 
Smart Energy Group is a full-service renewable solar energy company servicing Australia wide. They design and install bespoke solar solutions that reduce the energy costs of Australian households and businesses whilst improving Australia's green footprint.
They are seeking an experienced Office Manager to join their team Sydney, NSW.


The Role
The position is responsible for coordinating office personnel, allocating resources,
maintaining operational standards, managing records and reporting systems, and
ensuring effective communication between internal departments. The role also
contributes to workforce planning, process improvement, staff development, and
operational compliance to support business objectives.
This is a full-time position with an annual salary of $80,000 plus superannuation.

•	Establish priorities and service standards for sales administration and scheduling functions
•	Monitor operational workflows and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency
•	Ensure effective coordination between Sales, Operations, Installation and Administration departments

•	Coordinate office resources, equipment and systems to support business activities
•	Monitor team capacity and operational demands to ensure service delivery targets are met

•	Conduct performance reviews and contribute to performance management processes

•	Respond to internal stakeholder requests and support continuous business improvement initiatives

•	Minimum 3 years’ experience managing records, schedules, correspondence, and operational documentation in a commercial environment
•	At least 3 years’ experience supporting multidisciplinary teams within property, real estate, or customer service environments
•	At least 3 years’ experience using office management systems, Microsoft Office applications, and business administration software
•	Strong knowledge of office administration procedures, workflow coordination, and document management practices
•	Ability to manage competing priorities and maintain operational efficiency in a fast-paced environment

•	Ability to prepare reports, maintain accurate records, and manage confidential information professionally
•	Good understanding of workplace compliance, administrative controls, and customer service standards
•	Ability to work independently and support business operations within structured deadlines
•	High attention to detail and problem-solving capability

result.description:
A growing commercial cleaning and facilities services business is seeking an experienced Corporate Services Manager to oversee business operations, service delivery, client relationships and portfolio performance across South Australia, Victoria and Western Australia.

This is a senior management position suited to someone with strong experience in commercial cleaning, facilities services, multi-site operations, client relationship management, workforce leadership and operational performance.

The successful candidate will work closely with the executive leadership team to ensure operational standards, labour performance, compliance, client satisfaction and business growth objectives are achieved.

About the Role

The Corporate Services Manager will be responsible for planning, coordinating and improving the administrative, operational and commercial functions of an allocated portfolio.

The role will involve oversight of service delivery, client relationships, staffing, performance management, compliance systems, reporting, audits, business improvement and portfolio development opportunities.

This role requires a hands-on leader who can manage competing priorities, support Area Managers and site teams, maintain strong client relationships and contribute to the continued growth and professionalism of the business.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

Oversee the administration and operational performance of cleaning and facilities services across the allocated portfolio.
Work with the executive leadership team to support business planning, portfolio performance and strategic objectives.
Monitor labour-to-sales performance, roster structures, site profitability and operational results.
Manage client relationships and act as a senior escalation point for service delivery matters.
Identify opportunities for account growth, additional works, recharges, tender opportunities and new business leads.
Support tendering, quoting and commercial submissions where required.
Lead, support and performance manage Area Managers, Supervisors and cleaning teams.
Ensure appropriate staffing, training, succession planning and workforce coverage across the portfolio.
Monitor compliance with company systems, operational procedures, WHS requirements, audits, toolbox talks and site documentation.
Ensure cleaning standards, site presentation and service quality meet company and client expectations.
Support injury management and return-to-work processes in line with company HR and WHS protocols.
Review site performance data, audit outcomes, customer feedback and operational risks.
Implement process improvements to strengthen consistency, productivity and service delivery.
Represent the business professionally in client meetings, operational reviews and portfolio development activities.
Skills and Experience Required

The successful candidate will ideally have:

Previous experience in a senior operations, corporate services, facilities management or commercial cleaning management role.
Strong experience managing multi-site service delivery teams.
Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and resolve operational issues quickly and professionally.
Experience with labour management, rostering, cost control and performance reporting.
Understanding of WHS, compliance, audits and quality standards in a service-based environment.
Ability to lead managers, supervisors and frontline employees across multiple locations.
Strong communication, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
Commercial awareness, including the ability to identify growth, quoting and additional service opportunities.
Strong computer literacy and ability to use business systems, reporting tools and operational platforms.
Current driver licence and willingness to travel as required across the allocated portfolio.
Qualifications

Relevant qualifications in business, management, operations, facilities management or a related field will be highly regarded.

Equivalent industry experience in commercial cleaning, facilities services, multi-site operations or service-based management will also be considered.

What We Offer
Senior full-time management role with a growing service-based business.
Salary range of $115,000 - $135,000 per annum plus superannuation.
Company vehicle and fuel card.
Laptop and mobile phone.
Opportunity to work closely with the executive leadership team.
Broad portfolio responsibility across SA, VIC and WA.
Long-term opportunity to contribute to business growth, service improvement and operational excellence.
How to Apply

Please submit your resume and a short cover letter outlining your experience in corporate services, facilities services, commercial cleaning operations, client management and team leadership.

We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage applications from suitably qualified candidates with the right skills, experience and work rights for the role.

Engaged Finance is a growing mortgage brokerage based in Melbourne's inner west. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional advice, outstanding customer service and creating long-term relationships with our clients.

We're looking for a motivated Mortgage Broker who is hungry to grow their career and become a key part of our business.

As a Mortgage Broker at Engaged Finance, you'll work with a steady flow of business-generated leads while also proactively building your own referral network and client relationships. You'll be responsible for managing clients throughout the entire lending journey, from the initial enquiry through to settlement and beyond.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Meeting with clients to understand their financial goals and borrowing needs.
- Recommending suitable lending solutions from our panel of lenders.
- Converting business-generated leads into settled home loans.
- Prospecting and developing relationships with referral partners to generate new business.
- Preparing and submitting loan applications.
- Liaising with lenders, solicitors, conveyancers and other stakeholders.
- Working closely with our loan processing team to ensure a seamless client experience.
- Providing exceptional customer service and ongoing support to clients.
- Maintaining accurate client records and CRM updates.
- Achieving monthly settlement and activity targets.

What We Offer

- Competitive Base Salary + Commission + Superannuation
- Unlimited leads provided by the business
- Vibrant, young and supportive office environment
- Dedicated loan processing support
- Modern office located in Yarraville
- Genuine career growth opportunities

This role is ideal for a motivated broker who enjoys helping clients, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and wants to maximise their earning potential while working within a supportive and energetic team.

Location: Nightcliff NT 0810
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: AUD $90,000 – $110,000 plus superannuation

About us
Skills and Hands NT Pty Ltd is a Northern Territory-based consultancy focused on workforce planning, talent engagement, and sustainable staffing strategies. We work alongside local businesses to support the development of strong, reliable teams through tailored pathways that align with their long-term goals. Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory.

About the business
The business (ABN 24 638 483 600) is a locally owned real estate agency in Darwin, Northern Territory, servicing Darwin and Palmerston. They provide real estate sales, rental, property management and client-focused real estate services. They are seeking an experienced Sales and Marketing Manager to lead agency growth, sales strategy, marketing campaigns and client acquisition.

About the Role
The Sales and Marketing Manager will plan, direct and coordinate the agency’s sales and marketing activities. The role will focus on growing property listings, improving brand visibility, developing client acquisition strategies and supporting the agency’s long-term business growth in the Darwin and Palmerston property markets.

Duties and Responsibilities
The successful applicant will be responsible for:
- Developing and implementing sales and marketing strategies for the agency.
- Leading campaigns to attract property sellers, buyers, landlords and tenants.
- Setting sales targets, marketing objectives and business development plans.
- Managing marketing budgets, campaign priorities and promotional activities.
- Reviewing market trends, local property data and competitor activity.
- Developing strategies to grow the agency’s property management portfolio and sales listings.
- Managing brand positioning, client engagement and digital marketing direction.
- Coordinating advertising campaigns for properties and agency services.
- Supporting and guiding staff involved in sales, marketing, leasing and client engagement.
- Building relationships with clients, referral partners, contractors and community networks.
- Monitoring campaign performance, enquiry conversion and business development outcomes.
- Preparing management reports and recommendations for business growth.

Skills and Experience Required
Applicants must have:
- A bachelor degree or higher qualification in business, marketing, management or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
- At least 3 years of experience in sales, marketing, business development or management.
- Demonstrated ability to develop and implement sales and marketing strategies.
- Strong leadership, communication and negotiation skills.
- Experience managing campaigns, budgets, performance targets and client relationships.
- Strong understanding of digital marketing, lead generation and customer engagement.
- Experience in real estate, property services or professional services will be highly regarded.
- Ability to analyse market trends and use data to support strategic decisions.
- Current driver licence is desirable.

How to Apply
We are looking for professionals who are passionate about real estate and can demonstrate their experience clearly and confidently.
To apply, submit the following:
- Resume outlining your work experience and references.
- A short cover letter (max. 300 words) explaining:
- Why you are applying for this position; and
- An example of when you showed excellent service, initiative, or teamwork (use the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action, Result).
- A Written Response (max. 600 words) describing how your skills and experience align with the responsibilities of the role you are applying for. Please structure your example(s) using the STAR method.

* Only complete applications that address all three components will be considered. Incomplete or generic submissions will not be shortlisted.

If you are interested in joining a dynamic real estate team and contributing to exceptional property and client experiences, we look forward to receiving your application.

Apply online only. Walk-in or telephone enquiries regarding this vacancy will not be accepted.

Applications close: 20 August 2026

We currently have exciting opportunities for Senior Consultant, Managers, Senior Managers and Directors across our Tax division.

Corporate Tax Advisory/Corporate Tax DDX
Our Corporate Tax division helps businesses understand corporate tax matters and comply with ATO filing obligations. We recognise that multinational businesses face obstacles in managing tax across different jurisdictions and we use our local and global expertise to cut through the complexity this entails. 

M&A Tax/Stamp Duty
The KPMG State Tax Deals and Stamp Duty teams work on the most significant transactions in the Australian Market. They are market leading teams supporting clients with tax due diligence, structuring, modelling, duty and land tax compliance and dispute resolutions. 

GST Advisory/GST DDX/Employment Tax/Payroll/Trade & Customs
Our Indirect Tax division within the KPMG Specialist Tax and Reward business consists of market leading teams that provide high-touch, value-add advisory and compliance services. We support clients across the market through consulting on FBT, payroll tax, superannuation obligations, GST advice and international trade strategy.

GMS Tax Advisory/GMS DDX
Our Global Mobility Services teams are part of the KPMG People Services business in Australia and offers both Australian and international tax services to clients. We work across all areas of Global Mobility and related tax matters providing a high-touch, value-add advisory and compliance services to our clients.

Performance & Reward
KPMG’s Performance & Reward team is our leading remuneration practice advising ASX200 and unlisted company Boards and C-Site on remuneration and reward issues. We help our clients implement remuneration plans to reward and retain their people.

Migration DDX
Our national immigration practice is a team of registered migration agents and administrators that manage the visa requirements involved in the relocation of individuals and their families from one country to another by working closely with taxation specialists and global mobility professionals. 

Transfer Pricing 
Our Transfer Pricing Services practice is an international team of economists, tax practitioners and analysts helping clients generate tax efficiencies and reduce the risk of challenges from revenue authorities. Our multi-disciplinary approach and global mindset enable us to cover issues such as developing and executing commercially viable transfer pricing policies, compiling documentation for revenue authority audits and complying with local revenue requirements.

Tax Governance & Transparency
The Tax Governance & Transparency team advises organisations nationally and internationally on better practices in respect of tax governance and sustainability through tax transparency and risk management disciplines. 

Tax Reimagined
Our Tax Transformation team assist clients in transforming their tax functions to increase efficiency, improve governance and accuracy of their tax reporting. 

Tax Controversy
Our Tax Controversy team complements KPMG's traditional service offerings by providing high-quality legal services to our clients. The team prepare for, manage and resolve tax disputes, whilst maintaining an effective working relationship with revenue authorities.

Performance & Reward

•	Sector experience within consulting, a large listed corporate, or government

•	You are committed to providing fantastic customer service, with kindness and empathy at the heart of every interaction.

Transfer Pricing

Tax Controversy

Mizar Partners Pty Ltd is an Australian professional accounting and business advisory firm with offices in Melbourne and Sydney. We provide accounting, taxation, compliance and business advisory services to individuals, sole traders, small and medium-sized businesses, and corporate clients across a wide range of industries.
Our services include bookkeeping, management accounting, taxation, tax planning, business advisory, cash flow management, SMSF support, entity structure advice, financial reporting and compliance support. We focus on providing practical accounting and taxation solutions to help clients maintain accurate financial records, meet their statutory obligations, understand their financial position and make informed business decisions.
Vacant Position: Senior Accountant

The successful applicant will be responsible for preparing, reviewing, analysing financial and taxation information for clients, assisting with statutory compliance, preparing financial statements and tax returns, supporting business advisory work, and providing professional accounting support across a range of client matters.
This role is suited to a professional with strong technical knowledge in accounting, taxation, financial reporting, business compliance, accounting systems, budget analysis, cash flow management and client advisory services.
Hiring Type: Permanent Full-time
Salary Range: Above AUD82,000 + super/ per year 
(The remuneration will depend on the skills, outcomes and experience you can deliver. )
Working Location: Melbourne
Qualification Requirements:
•	Above Master’s degree from Australia or overseas tertiary education provider is a must;
•	Must have a minimum of 3 years’ relevant accounting experience in public practice or business services.
•	Strong communication skills required, including proficiency in English and Mandarin.
•	Hands-on public practice experience delivering end-to-end tax, BAS and financial reporting services for Australian SME.
•	In-depth working knowledge of ATO legislation, payroll compliance, FBT, GST, PAYG and superannuation regulatory rules.
•	Strong proficiency with cloud accounting platforms and advanced Excel for financial modelling and reconciliation.
•	CPA/CA qualified or currently undertaking professional accounting accreditation will highly regarded.
•	Strong knowledge of Australian taxation law and compliance requirements.
•	Clear written and verbal communication skills to deliver straightforward financial advice to non- 
financial business owners.

Roles and Responsibility:
This is a senior level accounting service role, with core duties including:
?	Conduct payroll reviews fully compliant with ATO standards, including superannuation contribution calculations and salary packaging deduction audits.
?	Prepare month-end accounting deliverables: cash flow statements, journal entries, ad-hoc performance reports, monthly budgets, balance sheets and formal management reporting packs.
?	Prepare, reconcile and lodge all compliance documentation including Business Activity Statements (BAS), individual, company, partnership and super fund tax returns covering GST, PAYG instalments, PAYG withholding and all statutory tax obligations.
?	Design, update and refine internal financial workflows and general accounting procedures to boost operational efficiency and accuracy.
?	Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support for cloud-based accounting software systems used by internal teams and SME clients.
?	Compile complete financial statements (balance sheet, profit & loss, cash flow statements), conduct line-by-line account reviews and general ledger reconciliations, and deliver profitability, liquidity and financial health analysis to firm management and directors.
?	Prepare, validate and submit accurate annual Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) filings for all client entities.
?	Deliver customised professional taxation and structural advice to clients covering business setup,     
growth planning and daily operational financial optimisation.
?	Build robust financial control frameworks to protect client asset integrity, analyse operational expenses and track organisational income and expenditure trends.
?	Serve as the primary liaison for external auditors and support interim and year-end statutory audit procedures for all client portfolios.
?	Correspond and negotiate directly with the Australian Taxation Office (ATO) and other financial regulatory authorities as required for client compliance matters.
?	Identify legitimate tax minimisation opportunities, eligible claim deductions and profit-improvement strategies for individual and business clients.

Tour Guide Manager 
Business: Coffin Bay Oyster Farm Tours
Location: Coffin Bay, South Australia (Regional Area)
Salary: AUD 80,000 per annum plus superannuation
Employment Type: Full-time

Position Summary
Coffin Bay Oyster Farm Tours is seeking a full-time Tour Manager to oversee the day-to-day operation of our regional tourism business based in Coffin Bay, South Australia. This role combines operational management, staff leadership, financial administration, procurement responsibilities, and active participation in guided tours.
The successful applicant will report directly to the business owners and will be responsible for ensuring the efficient delivery of daily operations while maintaining high standards of customer service and operational performance.
Relocation to Coffin Bay, South Australia is required if not currently residing in the area.

Key Responsibilities
Lead and participate in guided oyster farm tours and tourism experiences.
Coordinate daily tour schedules, logistics, and operational delivery.
Ensure guests receive a high-quality tourism experience while maintaining safety standards.
Participate in outdoor operational activities and physically demanding tasks associated with tour delivery.
Oversee the daily operation of the business.
Recruit, train, supervise, and manage staff performance.
Prepare staff rosters and coordinate payroll processing.
Manage invoicing, financial reconciliation, and cash handling procedures.
Oversee procurement, supplier relationships, and inventory control.
Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety, food safety, hygiene, and relevant regulatory requirements.
Prepare operational reports and provide performance updates to business owners.

Essential Requirements
Minimum three (3) years of full-time experience in a Tour Manager or Tourism Management role.
Demonstrated experience supervising staff and managing daily business operations.
Proven experience coordinating payroll, invoicing, and financial reconciliation processes.
Experience managing operations within a small to medium-sized tourism business.
Ability to independently manage daily operations with minimal supervision.
Strong organisational, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work in a regional and remote environment.
Willingness to perform both administrative duties and physically demanding operational tasks.
Availability to work weekends, public holidays, and peak tourism periods as required.

Additional Information
This position requires a long-term commitment and a reliable, hands-on management approach. Applicants should demonstrate employment stability, strong leadership capability, and a willingness to relocate to a regional coastal community.

Only applicants who meet the essential selection criteria will be considered.
